address: Mariscal Antonio José De Sucre 676, Buenos Aires, C1428DUB, Argentina
bio: Any mention of Sucre, situated in the section of the Belgrano district closest to the sea and the extensive Regatas lake, cannot be made without referring to Fernado Trocca, a man with an entrepreneurial vision who successfully expanded his business model to other countries (Sucre has Michelin-recommended subsidiaries in London and Dubai). This spacious setting with an urban-industrial vibe, in which the open kitchen, long bar and glass-fronted wine cellar stand out, is aimed at a cosmopolitan clientele in search of new experiences.
